# Load the data

qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))
print("Sample of QA orders:")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']])"}
